providers.description: Cited research findings about the external world, distilled from prior web research and verified across sources: software release versions and feature lists (e.g. 'key features of Go 1.26', 'latest stable Rust version'), current events, third-party vendor and product facts, and other 'what is the latest X' answers. Route here for ANY external-world factual question — the store may already hold the verified, citation-backed answer (project-scope knowledge) without touching the live internet. Not for questions about this project's own code, scenarios, configuration, or how past work here was done.

tests.name: web-search findings — semantic recall corpus
tests.description: Golden corpus for the findings knowledge store. Positive cases assert that a finding's id lands within expect_within_top_k for a natural-language query about its claim. The corpus is seeded at runtime by the scenario; cases here document the intended recall behavior.

providers.description: Live web search via SearXNG. External, rate-limited corpus: reached only on an explicit --type web / --all selector, never on the default federated (auto) query path. Returns raw web results; no synthesis on the federation path.
